cards.answer: Seraphine is a support mage with AP-scaling magic damage. She repeats basic spells, protects nearby allies, and chains crowd control through enemies.
cards.counterplay: Spread out, sidestep her waves, and avoid lining up behind champions.

citations.quote: Name: Seraphine. Official role tags: Support, Mage.
Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine.
Active: Seraphine shields herself and nearby allied champions for a short time.
Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.
The charm from Encore, which is an immobilize, can trigger the stun from Beat Drop.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing her team protection and crowd-control chains helps avoid dangerous group engagements.

cards.answer: Every third basic spell casts twice. Ability casts grant Notes to Seraphine and nearby allied champions; her next basic attack consumes the Notes for bonus range and magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Account for repeated spells and keep your distance from her empowered attacks.

cards.answer: Surround Sound shields Seraphine and nearby allied champions and grants movement speed. If Seraphine is already shielded when she casts it, a delayed pulse also heals her and nearby allied champions based on their missing health.
cards.counterplay: Avoid committing damage into fresh shields and account for the delayed heal.

cards.answer: Beat Drop deals magic damage and slows enemies in a line. Against enemies already affected by Seraphine's or her allies' crowd control, it roots slowed targets or stuns immobilized or grounded targets. An echoed cast can turn its own slow into a root.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the wave and play cautiously when slowed or caught by her team's crowd control.

cards.counterplay: Spread sideways and avoid standing in line behind champions on either team.
